scope: pure CPU aggregation, serialization, field-signature, and checkpoint-metadata contracts only

fixed_design.input: raw RADIO observations indexed by view, primitive, and feature channel
fixed_design.semantic_direction: responsibility-weighted mean of per-observation unit directions, renormalized once per primitive
fixed_design.log_amplitude: responsibility-weighted population mean of log L2 amplitude over strictly positive-amplitude observations
fixed_design.directional_resultant: norm of the responsibility-weighted mean unit direction
fixed_design.log_amplitude_std: responsibility-weighted population standard deviation in log-amplitude space
fixed_design.observation_evidence: sum of effective responsibility weights attached to positive-amplitude observations
fixed_design.visibility_purity: effective responsibility mass divided by visible mass
fixed_design.zero_amplitude_policy: exclude before logarithm; never evaluate log(0)
fixed_design.invalid_row_policy: valid is false and every emitted tensor value is exactly zero
fixed_design.reliability_contract: ordered scalar column names and their canonical JSON SHA-256 are persisted and validated
fixed_design.schema_policy: new cache and checkpoint schema; canonical-mpr-v1 and canonical checkpoint schema-v1 remain unchanged

required_invariants: uniform positive feature scaling changes log amplitude by log(scale) and leaves direction/reliability unchanged
adding equal-amplitude opposite-direction evidence changes directional dispersion without changing log amplitude
invalid and zero-amplitude rows are finite and exactly zero
field signature and checkpoint metadata fail closed on every factorized-contract or scalar-column mismatch
